svg.text: Engagement concentrates in a handful of comments
Most-engaged comments. Bar length is engagement; 134 = full width.
"“Trying to sell us a solution to a problem they created”— I don’t think I’ve ever said
this before, but I wish I could give this multiple 👍"
"Behind every 'rogue' AI, is a wizard of Oz type rogue human."
"I think we're in big trouble as long as these tech companies are allowed to continue
with no regulations or laws."
"I love that she mentions that the perpetuating of saying AI itself is evil absolves
openAI from their responsibility THIS is the key message."
"A new "Watchdog" agency is needed for all of this."
"Been saying for awhile the danger isn't AI it's who's developing & controlling it."
"Wow! Phenomenal guest very informational. Thank you"
"This is the most intelligent, cogent, clearly stated and non-sensationalistic
commentary on the issue that I've seen. She should be on every talk show!"
"Never trust Sam Altman"
"One would think that after an incident like this Congress would have been busy drawing
up regulations to govern the companies and what they are allowed to do with this
technology."
"Thanks PBS for not falling for the 'agents went rogue' explanation and seeing this for
what it is - carelessness on the part of AI companies."
"I'm glad I watched this commentary. Heidi Khlaaf is brilliant and was really good at
explaining what happened in a manner that actually made sense to a computer language
illiterate such as myself."
Agrees
